Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Wikipedia page and inverted the conflicting birthplace claims—stating the article body said Buenos Aires while the infobox listed Madrid, when the visible content showed the opposite. This misinterpretation impaired source evaluation and led to undue reliance on IMDb without resolving the discrepancy via other authoritative sources, setting the path toward an incorrect birthplace conclusion.
